name: TODO count
description: Gives agents a tool that counts TODO and FIXME comments in a directory.

tools.name: count_todos
tools.title: Count TODOs
tools.description: Count TODO and FIXME comments under a directory on the server's machine and list the files with the most. Skips hidden entries, node_modules, and files over 1 MiB.

directory.description: Absolute path of the directory to search, usually the thread's working directory.

top.description: How many files to list. Defaults to 10.
